findings.reason: the enumeration of files the node migrates must add `imas_codex/settings.py` (seat + env var + settings accessors) or the seat cannot resolve and the §21 guard fails.
findings.text: §25 adds a `discovery-relevance` seat (model `typesafe/jev-1.13`) and two `[tool.imas-codex.discovery]` settings but never names the registry and accessors that already own seat and threshold definitions — `MODEL_SECTIONS` frozenset at imas_codex/settings.py:141, `_MODEL_ENV_VARS` at imas_codex/settings.py:212, `get_model` at :235 and `get_triage_threshold` at :1009 — so the node's file list omits `imas_codex/settings.py`, and §21's landed AST guard (which rejects any seat string outside `MODEL_SECTIONS`) plus `get_model("discovery-relevance")` will both fail on the new seat.

findings.reason: the design should state which existing retry/cost/key helpers `call_decisions` composes (or extract them once in the owner) so the two call paths do not drift.
findings.text: §25 puts `call_decisions`/`acall_decisions` beside `call_llm_structured` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py` yet describes a fresh retry loop ("429 and 5xx responses retry with backoff"), its own key lookup (`get_api_key_for_service`), its own service/X-Title header handling and its own `usage.cost` extraction, all of which that module already implements for `call_llm` (:3046) and `call_llm_structured` (:2203), so without naming the helpers it reuses the new path is a second owner of the same machinery.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §25 hides the decisions protocol (request shape, answer validation, retry, cost) behind `call_decisions`/`acall_decisions` and the two relevance fields behind the triage/score/ingest stages; §14 hides create-only row preservation behind one option on `create_nodes` and one prefix helper instead of per-call clauses.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §25's `call_decisions`/`acall_decisions` re-implement retry-with-backoff, key lookup, service tagging and cost extraction that `imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py` already owns for `call_llm`/`call_llm_structured`, and the plan names no shared helper.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §25's Interface account names what it retires (eleven CodeFile triage fields, the `code/triage.md` LLM rubric, code's use of the `discovery-triage` seat, code's `get_triage_threshold()` read and ingest's `--min-score` read) and §14 names its retirements (`seed_missing_roots`, `create_child_paths`), so neither section adds surface without accounting for it.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §25 adds a `discovery-relevance` seat and two settings without naming the owner that already declares every seat (`imas_codex/settings.py` `MODEL_SECTIONS`/`_MODEL_ENV_VARS`, read through `get_model`) or §21's landed AST seat-name guard; §14 does cite its owners (`create_nodes`, `seed_facility_roots`, `reset_to_status`, `render_path_prefix_clause`) and searches them.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one-wrapper-style addition, `call_decisions` beside `call_llm_structured` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py`, states why the chat path cannot carry it (different request and response shape, model and endpoint).
